release_notes: Build 143 makes Factburst Quiz Manager explicitly quiz-only and retires the old generic fact-video workspace surfaces.
Removes Pixabay and Pexels from API & Connections, Test all connections, and the active settings experience, and clears their obsolete saved credentials.
Retires the legacy Images settings page plus the old Dashboard, Projects, generic Production, Media Library and Asset Review entry points while keeping the quiz workspace and publishing managers.
Keeps Resolve, FFmpeg/native quiz rendering, OpenAI, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and Website integrations because they are used by the current quiz creation and publishing pipeline.
